main_body: Round leaf canopy (rows 0-31) on a thin brown trunk (rows 30-43) with a dark green shadow base
top_band: Lighter green clumps at upper right of the canopy (rows ~4-14); the canopy reads as a rounded volume with lit top and darker underside, not a distinct flat band
evidence: The organic canopy is shaded as a rounded mass: the lit top (light green, upper right) shades down to a dark underside at rows ~18-30. A dark green shadow under the canopy sits above the trunk. Trunk and ground shadow ellipse sit below. It reads as a 3/4 tree with a top-lit crown, with no flat elevation or rim-only construction. The organic kind does not need a hard edge line.

style.evidence: The canopy has about 5 green steps, from dark through mid to light highlights with bright specular dots. The outline is dark green, tinted to match the leaves. Clumps are blocky and a bit larger than the reference's leaf-by-leaf detail, so texture is moderate. The trunk is a plain flat brown column with only 2-3 tones and little bark grain or root flare, thinner than the reference trunks. The ground shadow is flat dark green. Overall it is close to the reference but slightly less rich, mainly in the trunk and base.
